scope: Generated offline packets only; all reviewer and adjudication fields remain blank.

screening.scope: Reproducibility comparison only. The stored pilot decision is not a gold standard and this report does not estimate screening precision or recall.

current_lexical_rule.include_rule: at least one architecture term AND at least one security term
current_lexical_rule.ranking_after_inclusion: relevance score descending, then citation count descending

stored_pilot_metadata.conclusion: Retained fields do not establish that the stored pilot selection was produced by the current lexical rule; its historical procedure is not reconstructible from these metadata alone.

human_audit_protocol.recommended_process: two independent reviewers followed by adjudication

triple_provenance.scope: Legacy provenance recovery and an unlabelled human-audit packet. No human correctness labels are inferred by this tool.
triple_provenance.recovery_method: unique case/whitespace-normalized exact evidence-quote substring match

human_audit_protocol.design: coverage-first strata: relation type x model-reported score bin x publication year

entity_resolution.scope: Unlabelled pair sampling only; no merge precision or false-negative rate is estimated yet.
entity_resolution.nonmerged_pair_selection: top same-type lexical token-sort similarity candidates not merged by the current pipeline
entity_resolution.recommended_process: two independent reviewers followed by adjudication; calculate merge precision and false-negative controls after labels exist.
